title: Bias is a Math Problem, AI Bias is a Technical Problem: 10-year Literature Review of AI/LLM Bias Research Reveals Narrow [Gender-Centric] Conceptions of “Bias”, and Academia-Industry Gap
measurement_description: The paper, a literature review of 189 research papers on AI/LLM bias, measures the prevalence of studies that focus on 'religion bias'. It quantifies how many papers within its corpus address this specific axis of identity.
findings: The review found that 19.1% (36 out of 189) of the surveyed papers on AI/LLM bias included a focus on religion bias. This was identified as one of several identity axes studied, but was significantly less common than gender bias, which was the focus of 79.9% of the papers.
